weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
Grants HP+7.
At start of turn, grants "unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack)" and "unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces" to unit for 1 turn.
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Def+6,【Fire Emblem】, and 【Null Undefended】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Def/Res+16 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (including area-of-effect Specials; excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 (including area-of-effect Specials; excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials), neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit, and grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit before foe's first attack and before foe's first follow-up attack during combat.
【Fire Emblem】
Neutralizes "effective against" bonuses for all movement types.
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = highest bonus on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit (calculates each stat bonus independently) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 10 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
【Null Undefended】
Neutralizes effects of【Undefended】.
(Only the Undefended status is neutralized, does not neutralize effects such as "when unit is in combat, foes' Savior effects will not trigger".)
【Undefended】
Unit cannot be protected by Savior through their next action.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

When Special triggers, boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.
Grants HP+7.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by 40% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Def+5 and neutralizes penalties to Atk/Def during combat, and restores 10 HP to unit or ally after combat.

a.d:
Grants HP+7 and Atk/Spd/Def/Res+12.
Unit deals +7 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 7 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

b.d:
Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
For foes on the map whose Res < unit's Res at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X (X = number of types of Bonus effects, excluding stat bonuses, and Penalty effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team; max 7), neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.), and reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Inflicts Atk/Def-5 on foe, unit deals damage = 25% of unit's Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 25% of unit's Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and neutralizes effects that prevent unit's counterattacks during combat.
If unit initiates combat, if foe initiates combat and the number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≥ 4, or if it is unit's first or second combat this turn initiated by foe where the number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≤ 3, calculates damage from foe's attacks at 50% (excluding area-of-effect Specials; this calculation stacks with other effects that calculate damage at X% such as Potent Follow) and triggers 【Potent Follow 100%】during combat.
【Potent Follow 100%】
Triggers an additional follow-up attack immediately after unit's standard follow-up attack and deals damage = 100% of unit's normal attack damage (if unit cannot make a follow-up attack, this effect triggers when the standard follow-up attack would occur; this effect is treated like a follow-up attack, so effects like "reduce damage by X%" still apply, but this effect is not affected by effects that prevent follow-ups or "attacks twice" effects; only highest value applied; does not stack).

c.d:
If a foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage and initiates combat against an ally adjacent to unit, triggers【Savior】on unit.
If unit triggers Savior, grants Atk/Def+1 during combat.
【Savior】
Unit takes ally's space, enters combat in ally's place, and receives all after-combat effects.
Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.

on unit.

If sword, lance, axe, bow, dagger, or beast foe initiates combat against an ally within 2 spaces of unit, triggers【Savior】on unit.
If foe uses sword, lance, axe, bow, dagger, or beast damage, grants Atk/Def+4 to unit, disables foe's effects that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" (including area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and unit's next attack deals damage = 40% of foe's attack damage prior to reductions (resets at end of combat; only highest value applied; does not stack).

Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.
